title: Telluric absorption lines 3000-25000 A (HITRAN2024)
selection: isolated-line central depth >= 0.01 after Gaussian LSF R=100000, airmass 1, observer at sea level, AFGL-1986 U.S. Standard atmosphere (CO2, CH4, N2O profiles scaled to NOAA GML 2025 global annual means: CO2 425.63 ppm, CH4 1935.95 ppb, N2O 338.86 ppb), Voigt profile, line mixing and continua ignored

columns.wavenumber_vac_cm-1: HITRAN transition wavenumber in vacuum at zero pressure, verbatim F12.6 string
columns.lambda_air_A: derived: lambda_vac / n_air, n from Peck & Reeder 1972 standard air (15 C, 101325 Pa, dry); formula fitted 0.185-1.69 um, extrapolated beyond 1.69 um
columns.nu_unc_code: HITRAN position uncertainty code (0 unreported; k: 10^-k <= err < 10^-(k-1) cm^-1)
columns.lambda_unc_max_mA: derived upper bound of the position uncertainty from nu_unc_code, in mA
columns.S296_cm-1/(molec.cm-2): HITRAN line intensity at 296 K, weighted by terrestrial isotopic abundance
columns.S_unc_code: HITRAN relative uncertainty code for S (3: >=20%, 4: 10-20%, 5: 5-10%, 6: 2-5%, 7: 1-2%, 8: <1%...)
columns.delta_air_cm-1/atm: air pressure shift at 296 K (nu* = nu + delta_air*p); 0.000000 often means unknown
columns.delta_unc_code: HITRAN absolute uncertainty code for delta_air (0 = unreported)
columns.dlam_pshift_1atm_mA: derived: vacuum-wavelength shift (mA) produced by delta_air at p = 1 atm
columns.p_eff_atm_sl: derived: S(T)*column-weighted mean pressure of the absorbing column (sea-level model)
columns.dlam_pshift_eff_mA_sl: derived: wavelength shift (mA) of an unsaturated line seen through the sea-level model atmosphere
columns.lambda_vac_obs_sl_A: derived: lambda_vac_A + dlam_pshift_eff_mA_sl/1000 = expected (pressure-shifted) vacuum position seen from sea level
columns.lambda_air_obs_sl_A: derived: the same converted to standard air (Peck & Reeder 1972)
columns.depth_R1e5_sl: derived: central depth of the isolated line after convolution with a Gaussian LSF of FWHM lambda/100000, airmass 1, sea level (selection quantity)
columns.depth_inf_sl: derived: central depth 1-exp(-tau0) of the isolated line, airmass 1, sea level, infinite resolution
columns.EW_mA_sl: derived: equivalent width (mA) of the isolated line, airmass 1, sea level
columns.depth_R1e5_2p5km: derived: as depth_R1e5_sl but observer at 2.5 km altitude (PWV ~4.4 mm)
columns.depth_inf_2p5km: derived: as depth_inf_sl but observer at 2.5 km altitude
columns.region: derived: contiguous spectral region of selected lines of the molecule (gap > 40 cm^-1 starts a new one), named by median lambda_vac in um
columns.EW_mA_2p5km: derived: same as EW_mA_sl but observer at 2.5 km altitude
columns.band: vibrational/electronic band from HITRAN global quanta (upper-lower)
columns.band_group: band grouping (O2 electronic bands; H2O polyad change dP=2v1+v2+2v3; others by band)
